description: This PHP source file defines the 'CallableResolver' class within the Slim Framework, which is responsible for resolving various callables, such as route handlers and middleware, including support for container-based dependency injection and notation parsing.

classes.name: CallableResolver
classes.description: Final class implementing logic to resolve callables for routes and middleware, supporting container-based resolution and special notation parsing.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a given input into a callable suitable for route or middleware handling, including container binding.

methods.name: resolveRoute
methods.description: Resolves a route handler callable, with route-specific resolution logic.

methods.name: resolveMiddleware
methods.description: Resolves middleware callables, accommodating different notation and container use cases.

methods.name: resolveByPredicate
methods.description: Private helper that resolves a callable based on a predicate, used for routes and middleware.

methods.name: isRoute
methods.description: Checks if a given object implements RequestHandlerInterface.

methods.name: isMiddleware
methods.description: Checks if a given object implements MiddlewareInterface.

methods.name: resolveSlimNotation
methods.description: Parses notation of the form 'ClassName:method' and resolves to an object and method for invocation.

methods.name: assertCallable
methods.description: Ensures the resolved value is a callable, throws if not.

methods.name: bindToContainer
methods.description: Binds a callable or closure to the container context if applicable.

methods.name: prepareToResolve
methods.description: Prepares various input formats into a standard notation for resolution, such as 'ClassName:method'.
